Oak Trees in Portland Parks (tibble).

Source: R/data.R
pdx_oaks_df.Rd

Oak tree characteristics measured on trees throughout the city parks of Portland in 2017. This data set is identical to pdx_trees except that this is data set is a tibble with projected coordinates contained in explicit X and Y columns.

Usage

pdx_oaks_df

Format

A tibble object with coordinates X and Y on a NAD83 / Conus Albers Projected coordinate reference system. Each point corresponds to an oak tree. The data has 680 rows, each corresponding to an oak tree and 13 columns:

  • X: the x-coordinate of the tree (distances are in meters).

  • Y: the y-coordinate of the tree (distances are in meters).

  • DBH: the diameter at breast height, in inches.

  • Tree_Height: the height of the tree, in feet.

  • Carbon_Storage_lb: the amount of carbon the tree stores, in pounds.

  • Pollution_Removal_oz: the amount of pollution the tree removes, in ounces.

  • Inventory_Date: the date that the tree measurements were taken.

  • Species: the species of the tree.

  • Common_Name: the common name of the tree.

  • Condition: the condition of the tree as a factor with three levels (Fair, Good, and Poor).

  • Collected_By: who the measurement was taken by (either Volunteer or Staff).

  • Park: the name of the Portland park.

  • Scientific_Name: the scientific name of the tree.

Source

Data were modified from the pdxTrees R package by Kelly McConville at https://github.com/mcconvil/pdxTrees/tree/master.

References

The data were originally collected by the Portland Parks and Recreation's Urban Forestry Tree Inventory Project (https://www.portland.gov/trees/get-involved/tree-inventory).
